title: Client Services Administrator
description: We are very pleased to be working exclusively alongside our professional, established and friendly client as they seek to recruit a Client Services Administrator to join their team on a full time permanent basis Client Services Administrator East Grinstead town centre area with parking available nearby / off site (approx £5 per day). 10-15 minute walk from East Grinstead station and bus routes. Full time permanent role - Monday - Thursday (Apply online only) with early finish at 1700 on Fridays. Office based role based in newly appointed very modern offices. £28000 per annum. 20 days holiday (rising to 25 with length of service) plus all UK bank holidays, good pension scheme, birthday leave as an extra day off plus great opportunities to learn and progress within the business. This is an excellent opportunity for a great team player who enjoys delivering outstanding service, managing documentation accurately, and supporting clients throughout important processes. Working closely with Consultants, senior stakeholders, and the wider operations team, you will play a key role in ensuring client records, documentation, and communications are managed efficiently while maintaining exceptional service standards. If you are detail-oriented, proactive, and passionate about providing first-class administrative support, we'd love to hear from you. The role - Client Services Administrator As a Client Services Administrator, you will support the day-to-day administration of client cases, ensuring documentation is prepared, processed, and maintained accurately. You'll be responsible for coordinating correspondence, supporting diary management, monitoring shared inboxes, and ensuring the smooth progression of client matters. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining confidentiality and professional standards. Duties and responsibilities include: - Maintain accurate client records, case notes, and administrative documentation. - Prepare professional correspondence and client documentation - Scan, file, archive, retrieve, and securely manage client records. - Track outstanding documents, signatures, and information requests. - Provide timely updates to clients regarding the progress of their cases. - Monitor shared inboxes and respond to routine enquiries - Coordinate diaries, appointments, meetings, and calendars. - Maintain stationery, office supplies, and departmental resources. - Handle confidential information in accordance with GDPR and company policies. - Assist with complaints administration, compliance processes, and data protection activities. Experience, skills and competencies required: Some office based experience in an administrative, client services, operations, or customer support role Excellent verbal and written communication skills High level of accuracy and attention to detail Confident using Microsoft Office 365, including Outlook, Word, and Excel Ability to manage confidential and sensitive information professionally Able to work independently and as part of a team For more information regarding this new and exciting Client Services Administrator opportunity, please apply now! Short-listing will take place soon - don't miss out! Berry Recruitment Services Ltd T/A First Recruitment Services is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy. Please note that no terminology in this advert is intended to discriminate on the grounds of a person's gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability or sexual orientation. Every candidate will be assessed only in accordance with their merits, qualifications and ability to perform the duties of the job

title: Customer Service Administrator
description: Morgan McKinley is working with a great growing company based on the outskirts of Horsham in the Partridge Green, West Sussex area who is looking for an experienced Customer Service Executive to provide excellent customer service at all times and be the first point of contact for all incoming enquiries. Salary: 28-32 K Location: Office based - Partridge Green. Own transport required due to location Hours: 8.30am-5.30pm Mon-Fri Customer Service Exec duties: - Act as the first point of contact for all incoming customer enquiries - Process customer information and qualify the call / order, what the customer is looking for etc. - Keep customers updated on what will happen next with their enquiry / order - Update the systems with the enquiry / order information - Maintain strong customer service and answer calls in a timely manner Skills and experience: - Proven experience working in a similar customer service - sales support type role ideally within the manufacturing, construction, or engineering sector - Highly organised and attention to detail - Good IT skills
